# Sam

## Appearance

Sam is a youth who is very tall and lank in stature. He is also described as having tow-colored hair.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Cressida P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008)_

## History

Sam was once disrespectful to Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) during a lesson. A hard worker, he managed to save money in the bank. He later made an unexpected and awkward marriage proposal to his neighbor [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), which she rejected.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P21](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0021), [v3 ch.Last P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036), [v3 ch.Last P40](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0040)_

## Quotes

> "Well, I’ve given some thought to acquiring a spot for myself. A location that would fit my needs exists in Millersville. However, should I take the lease, having a wife will be necessary."
>

> “You seem like a promising girl, and you move along at a good pace,” Sam stated. “A lazy woman isn't what I'm looking for. Give it some thought. My opinion won't be changing anytime soon. Anyway, I need to head off. The cows need milking.”
>
> — Sam — [v3 ch.Last P23](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0023)

> “Well, you could certainly do worse,” protested Sam. “I work hard, plus I have saved some money in the bank.”
